references.text: Jericho is called the city of palms, the same designation used in Deuteronomy 34:3
Jericho is the destination of the spies Joshua sends out, the city Moses sees from the mountain
Jericho is called the city of palms, the same description found in Moses' view over the land
Zoar is mentioned as the city Lot fled to, the same place Moses sees in his overview
Zoar is the city Lot reached when the sun rose, one of the border cities Moses sees
Zoar (Bela) is mentioned among the cities in the Valley of Siddim, the same area Moses looks over
Zoar is mentioned as a border city in the prophecy against Moab, the same place seen in Moses' vision
The plains of Jericho are named as the place where Israel camped, the same area Moses sees
The plains of Moab by the Jordan, near Jericho, are the same region Moses sees from Nebo
